name: GooeyNav-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A large gooey white blob is merging toward the Contact pill, showing the splash transition at its peak.

tagline: Gooey white blobs splash the active link into a pill.
summary: A short row of links keeps one item wrapped in a white pill. Clicking another link launches a cluster of soft white blobs that merge into a new pill around the chosen label.
appearance: Four short white labels sit in a row on a near-black stage, spaced widely apart. The current item is wrapped in a white rounded pill with black text, and stray white dots can hover around it.
behaviour: Clicking a link throws a spray of soft white particles across the row, which blob together into a white pill under that label while its text turns black.
demo_content: Four links labelled Home, About, Work and Contact.
search_phrases: links with a blob that jumps between them
nav item highlighted by a moving pill
animated menu indicator for a website
white pill sliding under active link
black background navigation with white buttons
top nav with squishy active state
use_when: A short site menu should make switching sections feel playful and obvious.
avoid_when: It is a minimal link row rather than a full header, and the particles add noise for frequent use.
customise: Items with a label and href, plus animation time, particle count, distances, radius, time variance, colour indexes and start index are props.
weight_why: A few links and about fifteen short-lived particle spans per click; idle otherwise.

a11y.note: Links fire on Enter and Space, but outline-none removes the focus ring and the particles ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: Links have no visible focus ring, so the keyboard position is hidden.
polish_why: A crisp gooey transition on a clean little menu; the effect is fun though the row feels bare.
